title_sq: RRUGA E BARRIKADAVE, APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 ne rrugen e Barrikadave tek gjimnazi Sami Frasheri.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3-te te nje pallati te ri ndertim i vitit 2022.
Perbehet nga:
-Sallon se bashku me kendin e gatimit. 
-Dy dhoma gjumi
-Dy tualete 
-Ballkon
-Apartamenti eshte i mobiluar me nje mobilim te ri dhe cilesor
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me teper informacion ju lutem kontakotoni
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale in Barricadave street near Sami Frasheri gymnasium. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building built in 2022. It consists of: - Living room with kitchenette. -Two bedrooms -Two toilets -Balcony -The apartment is furnished with new and quality furniture. It has proper mortgage documentation.
